profiles.name: el0-fpac-combine-sp-pauth-faults
profiles.scope: Actual unchanged NeverD combined authenticated SP-load exports in the official Arm model, with enhanced_pac2_level=3. Seven A/B, offset/writeback, discarded-destination and boundary-displacement words run through valid aligned completion and three fault stimuli: valid signed misaligned SP, invalid PAC aligned SP and invalid PAC misaligned SP. Original native words and all five generated routes must agree on complete ESR, raw signed SP, hardware execution origin and exact fault word; every guarded byte remains unchanged. EL0 with SA0=1, all four effective CPTA/CPTA0 controls, active controlled data keys and actual ID_AA64ISAR1_EL1 architecture-level readback. This qualifies model synchronous primitive fault ordering only, not an Apple call/frame/unwind ABI, asynchronous unwind, MTE, overflow or native Apple CPA2.

profiles.name: el0-sp-flow
profiles.scope: Actual NeverD raw-SP sequences across all 20 scalar, vector, pair and NEON memory identities. The completed original SP flows through copies into a second original SP load. HighC/LLVMC O0/O2 and LLVM ELF compare the second loaded value, completed SP and every buffer byte against independent original-word sequences, at EL0 with hardware-saved EL0t origin and SA0=1, under all four effective CPTA/CPTA0 settings. Model-only nonoverflow normal-return primitive qualification; no reconstructed call/frame/unwind ABI, asynchronous unwind, MTE, authenticated load, native Apple CPA2 or fault qualification.

profiles.name: el0-sp-pauth
profiles.scope: Actual NeverD combined authenticated SP loads for seven independent A/B, offset/writeback, zero-destination and boundary displacement words. HighC/LLVMC O0/O2 and LLVM ELF run at EL0 with hardware-saved EL0t origin and SA0=1 under all four effective CPTA/CPTA0 settings. The model reports real PAuth capability, enables EnDA/EnDB with readback, installs distinct controlled 128-bit data keys with readback, and requires both A and B signatures to change pointer bits. Independent native words compare loaded values, unchanged signed base versus authenticated completed writeback base, and all guarded bytes. Model-only successful-access qualification; no invalid-PAC/fault ordering, reconstructed call/frame/unwind ABI, asynchronous unwind, MTE, overflowing addresses or native Apple CPA2 qualification.
